# Explore Alberta Trails

> A student project showing a Banff-area map and current weather.

## Main page
- [Explore Alberta Trails](https://example.com/alberta-trails/): Replace this example URL with the deployed website URL.

## Important notes
- Weather is provided by Open-Meteo and may be temporarily unavailable.
- The map is provided by OpenStreetMap.
- This demo is informational; visitors should check official park notices and trail conditions.
